cli.a.ask:
Send a message and print the reply, in a new session unless -c or -s. If
subagents or background commands are started, wait for their reports and the
final reply. Without a message, read it from standard input; with - in the
message, append standard input to it. The reply goes to standard output, the
steps to standard error.
cli.a.config: Open the settings screen. The settings file is ~/.config/litemiyu/config.toml.
cli.a.root: Without a command, open the full-screen interface.
cli.child_behind: some of a subagent's messages may be missing
cli.denied.hint: add --yes to allow risky commands that need confirmation in this run
cli.denied.many: {count} steps needed confirmation and were skipped
cli.denied.one: 1 step needed confirmation and was skipped
cli.end.jobs_stopped: ; the subagents and background commands that had not reported were stopped
cli.hint.duration: use a duration such as 30s, 10m or 1h
cli.no_model: no usable model: none is set up
cli.not_utf8_arg: an argument is not UTF-8 text
cli.o.ask.cd: Work in the given directory (new sessions only)
cli.o.ask.file: Append this file's path to the message; repeatable
cli.o.ask.format: Output format (default: text); jsonl: one event a line
cli.o.ask.model: Use this model; a continued session keeps it
cli.o.ask.rescue: Rescue mode: saves nothing to disk (new sessions only)
cli.o.ask.yes: Allow risky commands that need confirmation
cli.o.root.rescue: Rescue mode: saves nothing; only a minimal set of tools
cli.rescue_missing: no usable model for rescue mode, missing {missing}
cli.rescue_no_config: the settings screen is not available in rescue mode (rescue mode saves nothing to disk)
cli.s.ask: Send a message and print the reply
cli.remote.asking: the session is waiting for someone at that window to confirm a step
cli.remote.ignored: this session is open in another window, so the message is handed to that window; {options} has no effect in this case
cli.remote.left_running: stopped waiting; the message was handed to that window and the session keeps running there
cli.remote.not_taken: the window that has session {id} did not pick up the message within {seconds} seconds; not sent
cli.remote.refused: the window that has session {id} picked up the message, but the session did not accept it
cli.stdin_not_utf8: standard input is not UTF-8 text
cli.taken: session {id} is open in another window
cli.taken_above: session {id} belongs to a subagent, and session {parent} that started it is open in another window
cli.v.name: <name>
cli.wait: · Waiting for {what} to report… (Ctrl+C stops waiting)
cli.x.ask:
No one can confirm risky commands while ask runs: catastrophic ones are always
refused; ones that need confirmation are refused and reported at the end
(exit 4) unless --yes is given.

Exit status:
  0  The turn ended normally
  1  An error occurred, e.g. a model error or the session is open elsewhere
  2  Bad arguments
  3  Interrupted, or --timeout or --max-steps reached
  4  The turn ended, but some steps needed confirmation and were skipped
  5  No usable model

Examples:
  litemiyu ask "What does this project do"
  cat error.log | litemiyu ask "Why did this fail" -
  git diff | litemiyu ask --format jsonl "Review these changes" -
  litemiyu ask -c --format json "How do I run the tests"
cli.x.root:
Examples:
  litemiyu ask "What does this project do"
  git diff | litemiyu ask --format jsonl "Review these changes" -
  litemiyu -c
  litemiyu --version

The rescue provider can also come from LITEMIYU_RESCUE_BASE_URL,
LITEMIYU_RESCUE_MODEL and LITEMIYU_RESCUE_API; the key only from
LITEMIYU_RESCUE_API_KEY.

Run 'litemiyu help <command>' for more on a command.
cli.hint.preset_rescue: Rescue mode only takes full or bare
cli.s.shellhook: Shell integration: talk from your shell prompt
cli.a.shellhook:
Hook LiteMiyu into your shell: type a sentence at the prompt and press Enter,
and it goes to the AI, with the answer shown in the shell; commands run as
usual. Supports fish, bash and zsh.
cli.a.shellhook.install:
Write one line into the shell's startup file; it takes effect in newly opened
shells. fish gets ~/.config/fish/conf.d/litemiyu-shellhook.fish, bash gets
~/.bashrc, zsh gets ~/.zshrc. Installing again only replaces what was written.
cli.s.shellhook.status: Show which shells have it installed
cli.s.shellhook.script: Print the integration script (called by the line in the startup file)
cli.s.shellhook.classify: Tell whether multi-line standard input is a command (exit 0) or a sentence (1)
cli.o.shellhook.shell: Which shell (default: detected from the parent process)
cli.o.shellhook.program: The program the script calls (default: this program)
cli.shellhook.stale: The shell integration in this terminal is an old version; reopen the terminal to use the new one
cli.shellhook.unknown_shell: Cannot tell which shell this is
cli.shellhook.no_home: HOME is not set, so the shell's startup file cannot be located
cli.shellhook.other.miyu: Miyu's shell integration is also installed at {where}
cli.shellhook.other.old: An old Miyu version's terminal integration is also installed at {where}
cli.shellhook.other.maybe: Miyu's shell integration may also be installed at {where}
cli.shellhook.other.twice: Two integrations would both take over Enter and send each message twice
cli.shellhook.other.miyu.fix: Two integrations would both take over Enter and send each message twice, so nothing was installed. Run miyu shellhook uninstall --shell {shell} to remove it first, then install
cli.shellhook.other.old.fix: Two integrations would both take over Enter and send each message twice, so nothing was installed. Delete the old version's file first, then install
cli.shellhook.installed: Shell integration installed into {path}; it takes effect in newly opened {shell} sessions
cli.shellhook.updated: Shell integration updated ({path}); it takes effect in newly opened {shell} sessions
cli.shellhook.foreign: {path} was not written by litemiyu, so it was left alone. Move the file away first, then install
cli.shellhook.not_installed: The shell integration is not installed for {shell}
cli.shellhook.status.gone: {shell}: installed ({path}), but the program it calls, {program}, no longer exists; install again
cli.s.shellhook.say:
Send the sentence on standard input to the AI and show the answer in the shell
(called by the script)
cli.s.shellhook.worker: The background process started by say (not run directly)
cli.o.shellhook.pid: The process id of the calling shell
cli.o.shellhook.terminal: This terminal's token (one session per terminal)
cli.o.shellhook.leftover: Write what was typed during the answer to this file
cli.o.shellhook.redo: This sentence is the previous one, edited and resent
cli.shellhook.say_failed: Cannot hand this sentence to the AI: {reason}
cli.shellhook.not_remembered: Cannot record this terminal's session, so the next sentence starts a new one: {reason}
